messages:
maria: quick async standup time — what I did: merged gw-routing PR (#482), updated policy docs for header-based routing. Blockers: seeing sporadic 429s in staging when jwt refresh spikes; not sure if batching window is too aggressive. Today: investigate 429s, add a short-term rate bump for staging canary, and pair with @jake on rollout plan.

jake: saw the 429s too. quick note — we measured request burst at ~1.6x expected for refresh endpoint between 08:12-08:18 UTC. suspect small clients re-trying on 401. Put a diagnostic flag on staging to log `x-retries` header counts.

olivia: FYI I left a review on #482 — small nit on the policy merge (missing `allowlist` case). otherwise looks good. also can help run the canary after you bump rate limits. :thumbsup:

maria: thanks @olivia, will patch the allowlist case. jake — can you share the quick curl to reproduce the retry pattern?

jake: sure — minimal repro: `for i in {1..20}; do curl -i -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -X POST https://staging-api.redwood.com/gw/refresh || true; done` — then kill token and run same loop from a second client. sends bursts when clients restart.

sam: question — is the staging rate bump config `gw-ratepolicy-staging` or `gw-ratepolicy-canary`? want to avoid accidentally changing global staging policy.

maria: good call. plan: create `gw-ratepolicy-canary` with +30% token capacity, scope to env=canary tag, and only apply to the subset of hosts in the canary pool. will open a quick PR and link here.

kevin: ping re: telemetry — if you enable the diagnostic flag, add a small metric `gateway.client_retries` with tag `repro=jwt_burst` so we can chart in Grafana. I can add the panel.

maria: noted — will include metric. also adding short-lived log line: `client_retries=%d token_status=%s`.

deploy-bot: Canary deployment started: gw-canary-2 -> pool:canary (maria). ID: cb-2026-05-16-09. Expected duration: ~8m.

jake: copying results here — after bumping canary +30% and enabling retry-metric, initial run shows 429s drop ~85% on canary nodes. still seeing edge cases when 3 clients restart simultaneously.

olivia: can we add a small Jitter backoff client-side in the recommendations doc? a quick snippet: `sleep=$((RANDOM%200)); sleep_ms=$(($sleep+100)); sleep $sleep_ms` — reduces synchronized retries.

maria: yes — will add a short note under docs/gateway/retries.md and link to PR.

kevin: I'll wire the Grafana panel and add an alert: > trigger if `sum(gateway.client_retries{repro="jwt_burst"}) by (job) > 50` in 5m. keep it low-signal for now.

sam: no blockers from infra side. if canary looks stable in 30m let's promote config to staging with feature flag `gw.ratepromo.v1`.

maria: plan for next 30m: patch allowlist, open canary rate PR, enable metric, run canary, and if stable promote. please @mention me for any sudden 5xx spikes. thanks all. :raised_hands:
